inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: a documentation append, no live model).

references.as_reported_note: Quality and reasoning-task comparisons are source-reported only; re-derive before forward-facing Carnot use.
references.as_reported_summary: Builds a discrete diffusion language model using Glauber dynamics and a pretrained causal/masked LM as the energy function; reports better quality than prior diffusion LMs and competitive results with comparable autoregressive models.
references.relevance: Direct EDLM follow-up surface: energy over the discrete diffusion trajectory, but with pretrained-LM energy support rather than a tiny from-scratch EBT.
references.title: Leveraging Pretrained Language Models as Energy Functions for Glauber Dynamics Text Diffusion

references.as_reported_note: Benchmark gains and convergence claims are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Frames masked-LM sampling as a reference policy plus an energy term and estimates that term online; reports improvements across autoregressive and diffusion language models on reasoning, coding, and science benchmarks.
references.relevance: Energy-as-residual-corrector precedent for the EDLM route: use an energy term to steer a language-model transition kernel without reopening the bounded Thesis-A generator route.
references.title: ETS: Energy-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Training-Free RL Alignment

references.as_reported_note: Validity bounds, stream counts, and comparison outcomes are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Provides a deployment-side conformal wrapper for RLVR-trained LLMs with anytime pathwise selective-risk control; reports evaluation over specialist benchmarks, adversarial shift cells, and live online-LoRA rounds.
references.relevance: Clean banked-verifier product surface: a per-round abstain/act certificate for adaptive streams, matching Carnot's selective verification mode better than static threshold prose.
references.title: Conformal Selective Acting: Anytime-Valid Risk Control for RLVR-Trained LLMs

references.as_reported_note: Length and latency reductions are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Trains an inference-time early-exit strategy from first-answer positions; reports 14%-55% average CoT length reductions and more than 2x latency reduction on practical reasoning datasets.
references.relevance: Tier-3 predictive-verification precedent: predict when reasoning has enough evidence to stop or escalate, instead of verifying only after the full process trace.
references.title: TERMINATOR: Learning Optimal Exit Points for Early Stopping in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

references.as_reported_note: Probe timing and token-reduction numbers are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Compares activation probes, early forced answering, and CoT monitors; reports that final answers can be decodable from activations earlier than monitors detect and that probe-guided early exit can reduce tokens with similar accuracy.
references.relevance: Warns that process monitors can trail latent model belief; Carnot's Tier-3 head should predict verifier outcomes from internal/process features while treating CoT text as gameable evidence.
references.title: Reasoning Theater: Disentangling Model Beliefs from Chain-of-Thought

references.as_reported_note: Mitigation and cross-domain generalization outcomes are source-reported only.
references.as_reported_summary: Models reward hacking as a Hacker/Auditor game and uses Auditor-Guided RLHF to gate reward signals; reports mitigation of sycophancy, verbosity, and code-gaming scenarios with cross-domain generalization.
references.relevance: Complements the `.346` verifier-gaming entry with a defense surface: adversarial auditing plus reward gating as a peer pattern for Carnot's gaming-resistance characterization.
references.title: Adversarial Reward Auditing for Active Detection and Mitigation of Reward Hacking
